scope: Real development localization pilot using existing provisional raw-observation labels. First block only. No production modification or final-test access.
data: prepared/observed_localization_pilot_v1_20261102:96 training windows/96 users,32 validation windows/22 other users. Labels are single-assistant observations, not independent physical gold. Validation labels were created/viewed during labeling; only algorithm outputs and parameter selection are new here, not a claim of blinded human review.
supported_target: Anchor-associated visible power/current change and native onset/recovery-completion point estimates. No effective-threshold duration, fault, causal participation, clean power or untreated reference targets.
originals: Run pinned CRAN CPOP1.0.10 beta=2log(n),minseglen0,exact pruning and pinned original LABS SIC M5/retest2/alpha1.01 on the identical native power sequence. Both fit native observation order x=1..n for the primary comparison because original LABS is index-based. This does not turn irregular timestamps into equal physical sample intervals. Map estimated positions back to original seconds; no input interpolation/resampling/filling. CPOP's optional unequal-time solver is not separately tuned in this pilot.
scale: Per-window robust descriptive power/current scales use first differences with gaps<=15s in pre-anchor [-60,-12] observations, MAD/sqrt(2), floored at .005kW/.05A. These are algorithm scales, not calibrated instrument errors. CPOP uses the power scale; LABS uses its original normalization. All extractors share these raw descriptive scales.
common_extraction: Determine signed direction from the first received-limit edge at0. Reference is the recorded preceding same-limit level, median over at most24s, allowed to be one point. It is an observed level, not an untreated counterfactual. Search onset from the last pre-anchor native observation to24s, requiring signed power departure>=max(.03kW,3*scale). Recovery-completion is the first later observation within max(.03kW,2*scale) of that preceding fitted level. No minimum dwell or isolated-point deletion. Quiet limit =>anchor not applicable.
one_candidate_direction: Retain CPOP fit and predictions as fallback; parallel raw current-and-power evidence may rescue a missed visible event and refine onset/recovery points. Do not delete/replace any native values or claim a new CPOP solver. Raw onset requires signed departures in both power>=max(.03kW,k*scaleP) and current>=max(.15A,k*scaleI); k in[2,3,4] is the entire parameter search. Raw recovery requires power and current within max(.03kW,2scaleP)/max(.2A,2scaleI) of their observed preceding levels. If this evidence has an onset, use its actual onset and observed return; absence of a return is an explicit null, scored as a failure where recovery is annotated, not zero duration.
selection: Training only: score all three k values, prefer candidates not increasing training false positives or misses versus CPOP; among safe candidates minimize equally weighted capped onset/recovery error. If no candidate is safe, retain that failure and choose the least-damaging configuration only for diagnostic validation, never adoption. Freeze selected configuration and source hashes before generating validation fits/outputs. No validation-output retuning.
sanity_checks: Also freeze raw-only evidence ablation and command-only timing/detection. If raw-only matches the candidate, do not attribute benefit to the CPOP solver. Command-only exposes the fact that many annotated onsets coincide with the anchor. These are diagnostics, not separate forecasting-module baselines.
scoring: Binary agreement only on manually resolved anchor labels; unknown/NA not negatives and their coverage is listed. Report FP,FN and provisional-label agreement, never certified real accuracy. Onset and recovery error: point distance to native annotation bracket and distance to first-observed endpoint, each capped180s; absent/failed estimates incur180s and remain in the denominator. Recovery estimates on clearly annotated no-recovery/censored positive cases are counted separately. Also report detected-only errors so capped penalties are visible. Native failures are retained and counted as failures where a target exists.
adoption: No production adoption from this small provisional development pilot, regardless of result. Current effective_response_refined is a simulation-specific30min/known-reference module and cannot be honestly run as the entire production algorithm on these irregular4min windows without q/reference targets; preserve it and mark scope mismatch. Only these comparable localization prototypes are compared here.
freeze: Existing128 windows and all old annotations, source hashes, user splits and production models remain unchanged. Closed test and external-test observations remain unread. No forecasting, report, second block, dependencies, GPU, deletion, commit or upload.
